Country.evidence_source: Many HEIs in the UK have recognised the value of offering new students a comprehensive induction to the institution and its services.

Type.evidence_source: This study also found that disrupted academic careers together with students' own perceptions of academic failure contributed to students' feelings of being trapped in intolerable positions from which suicide appeared to be an escape route.

Area.evidence_source: This study also found that disrupted academic careers together with students' own perceptions of academic failure contributed to students' feelings of being trapped in intolerable positions from which suicide appeared to be an escape route. ... such findings suggest the need for those involved in counselling and mental health services to work with academic staff to identify alternative 'escape routes' for students who may be distressed about the experience or possibility of academic failures.
